name: Paper Crane
summary: Discard a draft and the sheet folds itself into a paper crane that flaps off; Undo flies it back
about: Paper Crane turns discarding an email draft into a little piece of origami. The sheet lifts, folds in three real creases (you see the coral underside flip into view), becomes a crane and flaps away off the corner of the screen. A six-second Undo calls the crane back, lands it and unfolds it into the same draft, text and all.
how: Pick a draft in the row of tabs and edit the subject or message if you like.
Press Discard draft: the sheet folds into a crane and flies away.
Press Undo (or Ctrl+Z) within six seconds to fly it back and unfold it.
Once all drafts are gone, Bring back the samples refills the list.
